title: Clueless Killer Realizes He Murdered Two People
description:
Bodycam footage captures the moment a man was interviewed as part of an investigation during Daytona Beach Bike Week in 2022. Authorities were responding to the discovery of two individuals in a residential area not far from where the event was taking place. Investigators later identified Jean Macean Jr., 32, through a series of surveillance videos that appeared to show him with noticeable stains on his clothing. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
